title: Pinned YEIS population metadata adapter

scope.subject: Adapt the existing pinned MIT YEIS native galaxy and system materialization into the approved Personal Universe population metadata contract with stable provenance and world capability, while preserving native IDs, native Universe caching, localization, renderer ownership, and canonical navigation identity

research_summary: The default product path already reuses pinned MIT YEIS for native star/system identity, generation, Solar System data, reference frames, and a bounded recent-system cache. Agent 08 should not add a second native cache or universe graph. Extend the existing population contract as a thin adapter at buildYeisGalaxyIndex/resolveYeisSystem: authored Aurora stays authored; Sol/native Solar System is observed with inferred archetype/capability; named catalogue stars are hybrid because star identity is catalogue-backed while their YEIS planets are generated; procedural YEIS systems remain generated. Reuse the existing population metadata helpers, keep localized display names transient, and expose only narrow selected-system/world diagnostics for browser evidence.

sources.finding: The pinned MIT YEIS commit already owns native system identity, catalogue/procedural star generation, Solar System data and a small recent-system cache; the population layer should adapt its output rather than duplicate those systems or cache them again.

Solar System physical/orbital quantities are observational reference data; the adapter should keep existing native Solar values classified as observed while marking derived product archetype/capability as inferred metadata.
React Three Fiber remains the adopted rendering lifecycle host. Population provenance is data metadata and does not justify a new renderer, scene graph, or runtime framework.

search_ladder.conclusion: Reuse the pinned native YEIS universe and its existing system cache as the full astronomy execution/identity solution.
Keep the current R3F host unchanged; the adapter is pure population metadata and diagnostics.
Decorate the existing buildYeisGalaxyIndex/resolveYeisSystem outputs and reuse native catalogue/procedural/Solar identity instead of materializing a parallel system model.
Existing project metadata helpers and the native YEIS cache are sufficient; another cache, schema package, or astronomy library would duplicate authority.

coverage_matrix.capability: Default YEIS systems expose the same population schema as V2 generated/catalog systems
coverage_matrix.decision: Attach metadata to current native marker/system/world identities without changing IDs or destination constructors.

coverage_matrix.capability: Observed Solar, catalogue-star-generated, procedural and authored systems remain distinguishable
coverage_matrix.decision: Use observed, hybrid, generated and authored provenance based on existing native identity/source semantics.

coverage_matrix.capability: Repeated native focus remains memory-bounded and locale-safe
coverage_matrix.decision: Reuse YEIS Universe.system() bounded native cache and remap lightweight localized product definitions on demand; do not add another cache.

decision.rationale: The pinned native universe already solves identity, generation and bounded system lifetime. Reuse it and add only the approved metadata adapter plus narrow diagnostics needed to prove provenance/capability in the real browser path.
decision.fallback: If native adapter mapping becomes a measured hot path, optimize immutable metadata templates first; do not introduce a second native system cache without a new reuse-gate unit.
